judge_reasoning: The model's plan has a critical mana-accounting error. After using Press into Service (5 mana) and Highspire Infusion (2 mana), all four lands are tapped and Druid of the Cowl has used both of its available activations (only one 'free' untap is granted by Press into Service's copy trigger). Only Servant of the Conduit has one remaining activation (providing 1 mana), but casting Chandra's Pyrohelix requires 2 mana ({1}{R}). Total mana needed across the three spells (5+2+2=9) exceeds the maximum possible mana available this turn (4 lands + 2 uses each of Servant and Druid = 8), an unresolvable shortfall of 1 mana regardless of sequencing. Without being able to cast Chandra's Pyrohelix, the second Dragonmaster Outcast survives as a blocker alongside the Dragon token, and optimal opponent blocking (Dragon token blocks flying Mirrorwing, Dragonmaster Outcast chumps the higher-power ground attacker) leaves significant damage prevented, leaving the opponent alive. Thus the solution as written is not executable and does not guarantee a win this turn.
model_solution:
1. Activate Aethertorch Renegade: {T}, pay {E}{E} → 1 damage to the first Dragonmaster Outcast (it dies). Energy: 3 → 1.
2. Tap Mountain, Mountain, Forest, Druid of the Cowl and Servant of the Conduit (pay {E} → 0) and cast Press into Service targeting Mirrorwing Dragon, choosing NO support targets so the spell targets only Mirrorwing. Mirrorwing's ability triggers: you copy Press for Servant, Aethertorch, Druid and Zada. Each copy resolves, untapping that creature (Servant, Druid and Aethertorch are now untapped again) and giving it haste; then the original resolves and you gain control of Mirrorwing Dragon, untapped, with haste.
3. Tap Aether Hub and Druid of the Cowl and cast Highspire Infusion targeting Zada only. Zada's ability copies it for Servant, Aethertorch, Druid and Mirrorwing. All five creatures get +3/+3 (Mirrorwing 7/8, Zada 6/6, Servant 5/5, Druid 4/6, Aethertorch 4/5) and you get {E}{E} five times → 10 energy.
4. Activate Aethertorch Renegade again (it was untapped by its Press copy): {T}, pay eight {E} → 6 damage to the opponent (13 → 7). Energy: 2.
5. Tap Servant of the Conduit (pay {E}) for {R} plus one more mana and cast Chandra's Pyrohelix, dividing it 1 damage to the remaining Dragonmaster Outcast (it dies) and 1 damage to the opponent (7 → 6).
6. Attack with Mirrorwing Dragon (7/8 flying, haste) and Zada (6/6). The opponent's only untapped creature is the 5/5 Dragon token, which can block at most one attacker: if it blocks Mirrorwing, Zada deals 6 (lethal); if it blocks Zada, Mirrorwing deals 7 (lethal); if it doesn't block, 13 damage. The opponent is dead this turn regardless of blocks.
